item.title: Canada Opposition MP Wants to Open Channel With Yale Buddy Vance
item.description: Canadian opposition lawmaker Jamil Jivani attended Yale Law School with US Vice President JD Vance. He says that since his Conservative Party lost last April’s election to Mark Carney’s Liberals, he hasn’t discussed politics with his influential friend — just fantasy football and family.
